§4.3 · Catching

narrative.overview: An operating surface, not a game simulation or promotional page. A petrol shell, mint reference area, and white reading area separate the jobs. Native web controls and a compact system-sans hierarchy prioritize repeat lookup under ordinary indoor study lighting.
keyCharacteristics: Familiar form and expandable reference list.
Citation selection opens and focuses the exact evidence.
Textual state labels accompany every state color.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Related navigation never receives the label of a supporting answer citation.

dos: Do retain source labels, line spans, and textual state names.
Do render source content with safe text nodes and limited formatting.
Do distinguish operational errors from unsupported rules.
donts: Don't turn the app into a game board or invent game-state controls.
Don't hide unresolved rules behind confident-looking success styling.
